requirementMatrix.obligation: Create fresh private scratch and a separate retained HOME bundle only after platform, input and eligible-target checks; never admit the predictable old tree.
requirementMatrix.expected: One verified 0700 root of each kind per attempt; scratch under the trusted temporary parent, retained files under HOME.
requirementMatrix.observed: Current source calls the checked initializer after terminal and selection checks. Retained Linux controls demonstrate fresh roots across invocations, unsafe-parent refusal, and separate scratch/retained lifetimes.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Verify parent and ancestor ownership, modes, symlinks and physical identity using the native stat/id/-O/-L contract; unusual mounts fail closed.
requirementMatrix.expected: Private owned HOME, trusted temporary parent or root-owned sticky /tmp; physical path and device/inode identity must match.
requirementMatrix.observed: Source checks every supplied component and root identity. Retained WSL2 native /tmp controls reject symlink and writable parents. The old wrong-owner HOME fixture combines ownership and writable-mode factors; the isolated ownership cell is recorded below.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Qualify the actual macOS BSD stat/mktemp, Apple Bash 3.2 and filesystem staging branch.
requirementMatrix.expected: Actual /bin/bash --version, BSD utilities and native filesystem execution of initialization, writes, extraction, cleanup and retention.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained applicability explicitly records Apple/macOS BLOCKED. Linux and a PLATFORM=mac helper mock do not establish this platform cell.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Confine all outputs and cleanup to verified roots; reject symlink components, nonregular outputs, empty/dot/parent components and prefix lookalikes.
requirementMatrix.expected: No outside sentinel changes for leaf/ancestor symlinks, traversal or prefix lookalikes; changed scratch identity is never deleted.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained native helper controls pass five confinement cases and changed-identity cleanup. Current guards verify the root, component boundary and physical output parent at the real write consumers.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Separately discriminate wrong-UID retained-parent admission from writable-mode refusal.
requirementMatrix.expected: A reachable, non-writable foreign-UID HOME fails the actual initializer before staging; a matching same-UID HOME succeeds.
requirementMatrix.observed: The retained wrong-owner HOME control uses /tmp and combines wrong ownership with writable mode. Peer DAC tests establish isolation of created roots, not this separate initializer-admission discriminator.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Preserve the exact hostile old preset symlink and victim while producing valid configured JSON in a fresh owned bundle.
requirementMatrix.expected: Victim bytes and old symlink unchanged; successful regular JSON carries #lat=24.47&lon=39.61&method=4 in a private retained root.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained canary and configured-output assertions pass on source 9c3fd523. The source uses an exclusive owned partial, validates JSON, then publishes the final file; it never adopts the old tree.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Keep the asset/preset write chain closed: owned fresh partial, validation before publication, exact configuration, no usable artifact on malformed input.
requirementMatrix.expected: Valid new/cached assets work; invalid ZIP or preset fails with no artifact path; configured JSON remains exact.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained controls pass the cached/new asset, configured preset, malformed archive and failed-preset cases. Actual consumers recheck ownership around acquisition and publication. This is confinement and validation, not signature authentication.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Preflight all archive members before extraction; reject absolute paths, traversal and links, then extract into a new empty child and return a valid in-root manifest directory.
requirementMatrix.expected: Unsafe members cannot change an outside sentinel or extract an earlier marker; a valid nested Unicode/spaced manifest remains usable after exit.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained traversal, absolute, backslash, symlink, malformed, missing-manifest and safe-archive cases pass. The earlier-marker oracle detects extraction before preflight. Source additionally rejects special and duplicate members and creates files exclusively.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Retain legitimate same-attempt cache reuse but create new private roots on each invocation and retire old shared-cache admission.
requirementMatrix.expected: First/second same-attempt calls return the same validated path with one fetch; later runs use distinct roots.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained helper and predictable-root mutation controls establish both behaviors. The cross-UID owner run acquired only Chromium, Firefox and preset inputs, with no second Chromium acquisition.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Retain completed or explicitly partial manual bundles through exit, failure and interrupt; cleanup removes only unchanged owned scratch.
requirementMatrix.expected: Failed preset/extraction and TERM preserve the bundle; changed scratch identity preserves its sentinel; no retained EXIT deletion.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained helper/entry observations satisfy these controls. EXIT/INT/TERM handlers call scratch-only cleanup; TERM exits 143 and preserves the preset with a partial warning. Failed extraction returns no artifact and leaves its fresh partial child.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Prove retained filesystem consumption after source exit and a fresh consumer; keep it distinct from printed paths, later liveness, reboot and browser installation.
requirementMatrix.expected: A fresh owner process reads unchanged preset, manifest, payload, XPI and sentinel after owner exit.
requirementMatrix.observed: The recorded owner exits 0, scratch is removed, and a fresh UID1000 consumer exits 0 with exact retained bytes, identities, modes and valid JSON/XPI. A later readback reports fixtureExists=false, cause unknown. Credit remains bounded to the original exit/consumer observation.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Support the cross-user boundary with native Linux filesystem semantics, distinct UIDs and reachable positive controls; do not claim same-UID isolation.
requirementMatrix.expected: Actual source-created 0700 roots, reachable parents, distinct peer with no groups/capabilities; read/write/link denial and healthy peer controls.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained WSL2 Linux kernel 6.6.87.2, Bash 5.2.21 and native /tmp ext2/ext3 evidence records UID1000/65534, 49 operations: 30 EACCES(13) and 19 allowed controls. Parents are reachable, sentinels unchanged and no foreign entries appear. This supersedes only the earlier failed login route.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Keep dry-run outside both staging roots and all write, acquisition, extraction and cleanup paths; never return imaginary artifacts.
requirementMatrix.expected: Zero effects and unchanged subjects; initializer and cleanup unreachable; guarded helpers return no usable path.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained Linux ten preview/refusal cases record zero effects and unchanged subjects, with separate helper guards. The actual Apple whole-entry cell remains unverified under #22.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Use predictable-root, symlink-admission and retained-EXIT-deletion mutants to discriminate freshness, confinement and lifetime separately.
requirementMatrix.expected: Each valid mutant fails its intended control while the original positive remains healthy.
requirementMatrix.observed: Retained Bash mutations detect symlink admission and retained deletion. The separate predictable-root mutant completes its processes but returns the same scratch path across runs, detecting the freshness violation without counting a process error as proof.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named

requirementMatrix.obligation: Disclose retained HOME bundle lifetime, keep-unpacked instructions, optional manual preset/XPI removal, partial retention and retired cross-run cache behavior in README.
requirementMatrix.expected: Public instructions agree with the source and separate staging/Enter from manual browser success.
requirementMatrix.observed: Script instructions are correct. Delivered README lacks the required bundle/cache lifetime paragraphs that were present in the earlier reviewed documentation unit.
requirementMatrix.evidence_basis: fresh source examination; historical execution only where explicitly named
